question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Mercy
solution:
The correct answer is "**Sternness**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Mercy" means showing compassion or forgiveness towards someone.**(दया)

 
 
• Example: They begged for mercy.
 
 
 
• **"Sternness", on the other hand, means being strict or severe in one's actions or attitude.**(कडाई)
 
 
• Example: He directed the agency with the sternness of a military officer.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, sternness is the opposite (antonym) of mercy.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, Compassion, understanding or pity for somebody who is suffering.(करुणा)
 
• Option 3, Benevolence is disposition to good. (परोपकरी, हितकामना)
 
• Option 4, Grace means the quality of being pleasantly polite, or a willingness to be fair and honest. (अनुग्रह)
